name: The Wither Hunter (Akshan)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Akshan

Skin:  Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Aiming objetives after autoattacks.

-Spider, invisibility potion, minecart, fireworks, nether portal, respawn anchor and trapdoor included.

-Also totem of the undying included (or is it a pigtem of the undying...?)

-Absolutely not references to ARPG games.

-The prior feature is a lie.



__________

Legacy changelog:
1.0.0; 26/03/2025
first release version

1.0.1;
Fixed square bug on passive for new patch, changed particles to be harder to break in new patches.

1.0.2;
Particles routes changed to be much harder to break with new patches. This version was released in a moment when there was no bugs in the previous one, but might help new issues that appear in future League patches.

1.5.0;
-Halfway to the 2.0 in order to fix the issues of the new patch. Muted sounds fixed and also several changes and additions, the most important are: 
-Laugh emote added -Reduced character size 
-improved cape movements and other details in a lot of animations 
-Improved and fixed knockup and stunned animations and their transitions 
-New critical hit animation -New "low speed" autoattack transitions for early game; the old ones will trigger only sometimes, and more often as the game goes on until its 100% chance at around level 10. 
-Recall now has a fake shadow to indicate position and a new sound (FLINT AND STEEL!!)

1.5.1;
-Small sound fix from the last version (transformations were muted)

1.6.0;
-Added new laugh emote (now there are 2 laugh emotes, each triggers randomly when using CRL4)

-Fixed a bug that caused the character to make an annoying sound in a loop when dying.

-Fixed a bug that caused the character to not roll-out from the floor properly from the knockup and sunned effects.

-Fixed (I hope) a bug that caused the character to bug its animation in the air when knocked up sometimes.

-Fixed (I hope) a bug that caused the character to freeze its animation walking after some autoattacks.

1.7.0;
-Fixed for new patch.

-Repathed files for faster loading and breaking prevention.

-Added 3 new idle animations to the idle cycle.

-Fixed some minor bugs in animations.

1.7.1;
Fixed:

-Invisibility option not showing up in the W animation.

-Crossbow still being visible in the hand during spell 3 swings, clipping with the spider.
__________

Lore:

When it comes to defeat huge hordes of wither skeletons, no one is as effective as The Wither Hunter. He claims to have an edgy backstory of losing his family to the withers, but it is possible this is just a reference to one of his favorite games and the character he cosplays. He also has friendship with the Master Evoker, who gave him his special totem of the undying.

__________

Sources and references:

-Rig and model made mostly by me (some specific parts are extracted from Minecraft).

-The spider rig comes from this sketchfab post: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/minecraft-spider-5bab142d74d84f3cb6495bbaa96d04d3

-All animations made by me.

-Particle effects mostly made by me.

-The dance emote references Tristram Theme from Diablo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AnMR6SOBa9k.

-The character itself references the Demon Hunter from Diablo 3.

-The Taunt emote references the streamer Drututt and his Minecraft horror mods miniseries.

-The joke emote includes the first 3 Diablo games, Path of exile 2 and Minecraft Dungeons.

-The first laugh emote references the Minecraft movie as well as my previous Chicken Jockey Kled Custom Skin.

-The second laugh emote references Dante Axe and his animation series "Randomville".

-Special Thanks to Bud for helping with the render (this has become a tradition by now).

-Special Thanks to Nyht for helping with a crash-issue with the transformations.

-Special thanks to Dante Axe for the voicelines for the second Laugh emote.
